subject: 'Less bullish' (steep down-trendline)

lesson: Breaking above a steep falling line may only mean the decline is slowing, especially below the long-term MA.

subject: 'Most bullish' (horizontal resistance line)

lesson: An upside break of a near-horizontal line is the most bullish trendline break.

subject: Marion Labs (MKC) options

subject: Limited Inc - Mansfield (weekly)

subject: Limited (The) Inc - Horsey (monthly)

subject: Ocean Drilling (ODR; ASE)

subject: Reading & Bates (RB)

subject: 'Stage Chart' (generic stage cycle)

subject: Bethlehem Steel (BS)

subject: International Paper (IP)

subject: Levitz Furniture (LEV)

subject: Unnamed stock (ticker illegible)

subject: Unnamed stock

subject: Unnamed stock

subject: Unnamed stock

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 4

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 6

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 7 (marked NYSE)

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 9

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 10

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 11

subject: Unnamed quiz chart 12

subject: Starrett Housing (SHO)
marks: PTR up-arrow at breakout above 10 (turn of 1974/75); converging base lines

subject: ARA Services (ARA)

subject: Telex (TC)
marks: up-arrow at 1982 breakout above ~10
pattern: Stage1->2 breakout on extremely heavy volume
lesson: Breakout above 10 on extremely heavy volume gained ~680% annualised over three months; corrections held above the rising 30-week MA.

subject: Micropolis Corp (MLIS)

lesson: A potential Stage 3 top (15 to 19 1/2) failed; the second breakout above 19 1/2 on very heavy volume resumed Stage 2 (~250% annualised).

subject: Avon Products (AVP)

subject: Teleprompter (TP)
marks: arrow at break below rising trendline and MA (~36-38)
pattern: Stage4 breakdown (trendline + MA); sucker pullback rally

subject: Crazy Eddie (CRZY)
marks: arrow at late-1986 breakdown near 17

subject: Endotronics Inc (ENDO)
marks: arrow at late-1986 breakdown below MA and ~22 support
lesson: Collapsed from the low 20s to ~2-3 despite a brokerage 'buy' days earlier; every oversold rally failed below the MA.

subject: Gold, spot (weekly)

subject: Janus Fund (weekly NAV)
marks: up arrow at late-1982 break above declining trendline (~3-3 1/2; exact bar unsure)

subject: 'Ideal Buy for Investor'
marks: Point A where price breaks above base resistance and the MA
lesson: Point A: breakout above base resistance as the declining 30-week MA flattens and curls up, with volume expanding - low risk, whole Stage 2 ahead, may need patience.

subject: Mexico Fund (MXF)

pattern: Stage1->2 breakout followed by low-volume pullback (per text)

subject: 'Ideal Buy for Trader'
marks: Arrow A at breakout above the consolidation's upper line
lesson: Trader's ideal: in an established Stage 2, a consolidation near the rising MA followed by a breakout above resistance.

subject: Swift Energy Co (SFY; ASE)

subject: Stock XYZ base 8-12
marks: Arrow A at breakout above 12 resistance and the flattening MA; later pullback toward breakout zone
lesson: A breakout above 12 resistance as the MA flattens is the ideal buy; the bigger the base, the greater the upside.

subject: The Four-Year Presidential Cycle (Merrill)
marks: panels: Election Year, Next Year, +2, +3
lesson: The post-election year tends to be weak, year two bottoms around mid-year, year three is best and the election year is weak then strong.

subject: The Market Year 1897-1983 (% of years DJIA rose, by month; Merrill)
marks: monthly percentages vs 50% baseline (Aug value digit unsure)
lesson: December is best (68% up) and Nov-Jan strongest; Feb, May, Jun and Sep are weak, so ease off then unless charts are strongly positive.

subject: Market Performance Each Day of the Week, Jun 1952-Jun 1985 (S&P; Hirsch)
lesson: Monday is the weakest day and Friday the strongest, but these patterns only fine-tune aggressiveness; a good breakout is still bought.

subject: Western Union (WU)

subject: Oil group

lesson: The group broke out with RS turning positive while crude was ~$10 and news grim - strong technicals over bad headlines.

subject: American Oil & Gas (AOG; rigs/crews/oil-gas producer)
marks: up-arrow at breakout above ~4.25 base top and MA

subject: Computer Equipment group

lesson: The group finished a Stage 2 consolidation near the MA and broke out to an all-time high with strong RS, backing the Compaq/Micropolis/Tandem picks.

subject: Compaq Computer (CPQ)

lesson: With market, group and stock all positive, act immediately; Compaq ran from ~18 to ~50.

subject: Real Estate Investment Trusts group

subject: S&P 8 Brokerage Firms group

subject: Swank (identified in answer)
marks: up-arrow at breakout above ~7-7.5 base top
lesson: Investor-type buy: breakout from a long Stage 1 base (Swank, 1975 at 7 1/8, ~20 a year later).

subject: Apple (identified in answer)

lesson: Trader-type buy: consolidation breakout after a big advance (Apple through 39 in 1986, above 80 six months later).

subject: Regional banks group (identified in answer)

lesson: A stronger uptrend, no overhead resistance and recovering RS made oil the group to buy aggressively in early 1987.

subject: ABC (hand-drawn, no resistance)

subject: Allegis Corp (AEG)

subject: Pan Am Corp (PN)
marks: up-arrow at 1987 breakout (~6); line ~7 at early-1986 breakdown level
lesson: The breakout faced resistance near 6 1/2, 7 and above 8, plus a small base, mediocre RS and fair volume - graded C- versus Allegis A+.

subject: Reynolds Metals (RLM)
marks: up-arrow at early-1987 breakout (~23-25); '2/1' mark (probably split)
pattern: breakout from one-year range to new 10-year high; no overhead resistance
lesson: No overhead resistance for 2 1/2 years plus a new 10-year high, healthy RS and big volume - it doubled within months.

subject: International Aluminum (IAL)

lesson: Same group and timing as Reynolds, but heavy supply at 24 1/2, lacklustre volume and mediocre RS - it stalled and fell back to 20.

subject: 'Volume Ideal' (hand-drawn)
marks: breakout above range top with the tallest volume bars
lesson: Breakout volume should jump: at least 2x the prior month's average weekly volume, or a 3-4 week build-up of at least 2x.

subject: Allied Signal (ALD)
marks: up-arrow at late-1986/early-1987 triangle breakout (buy-stop example 43 3/8)
lesson: Breakout-week volume did not reach 2x the 4-week average; it topped at 49 1/4 - avoid, or take a quick profit near the prior high.

subject: Goodyear Tire & Rubber (GT; label read as 'ASE', unsure)
marks: up-arrow at late-1986 breakout (~48); pullback to ~40 near rising MA
pattern: breakout on ~3x volume, then pullback on >75% lower volume
lesson: Heavy breakout volume followed by a light-volume pullback near the MA signalled buying the second half in the low 40s.

subject: Puerto Rican Cement (PRN)
marks: up-arrow at early-1986 breakout (9); second up-arrow on the breakout volume bar
lesson: A roughly tenfold volume expansion on the breakout at 9 led to 38 1/2 fifteen months later.

subject: Texas Industries (TXI)
marks: up-arrow at early-1986 breakout above ~31; small down-arrow in 1985 (meaning unsure)
lesson: Contracting volume on the breakout was reason enough not to buy above 31 1/2; it fell to 22 while PRN kept rising.

subject: XYZ price vs RS (hand-drawn)
marks: flat price range 51-55; rising trendline under RS lows
pattern: RS rising during neutral price range
lesson: Rising RS while price is flat favours an upside breakout; don't short such a stock even if it breaks down (but owners still sell).

subject: Merck & Co (MRK)
marks: up-arrow at late-1985 breakout above 60; arrow on long-range inset
pattern: Stage1->2 breakout with RS crossing above zero; new long-range high
lesson: RS was rising before the breakout and then crossed above zero and kept strengthening; the price tripled.

subject: Adams-Russell (AAR; electronics mfr)
marks: arrow at breakout above ~15 (text: early 1986; chart reading suggested mid-1986); arrow on long-range inset
pattern: Stage1->2 breakout with RS crossing above zero; no supply above 16
lesson: RS improved in the weeks before and crossed zero at the breakout on impressive volume; the stock nearly tripled in 18 months.

subject: Alpine Group (AGI; precision machine parts)
marks: arrow at breakout gap (text: above 5 1/2 in early 1986; chart reading put resistance near 4.5)
pattern: Stage1->2 breakout; RS crossing from negative to positive after a 90-day rise
lesson: Sharply expanding volume, no long-range resistance and RS crossing above zero; the stock quadrupled in 18 months.

subject: XYZ price vs RS divergence (schematic)
marks: flat 50-54 range; declining trendline over lower RS peaks
pattern: bearish RS divergence during flat range
lesson: Deteriorating RS during a flat range warns the range will likely resolve downward; even an upside breakout is not worth buying.

subject: Acme United (ACU)
marks: A, B, C labelled on price and RS; arrows at breakouts B (8 1/2) and C (9 1/8)
pattern: breakouts with negative, falling RS (lower at each point)
lesson: Deeply negative RS in a 12-month downtrend, lower at each breakout though price was higher, ruled it out; it declined while the Dow rose.

subject: Care Enterprises Cl A (CREA)
marks: A and B; arrow at B (break above long down-trendline at 4 1/4)
pattern: trendline breakout with negative, falling RS
lesson: Breakout at 4 1/4 with RS negative, in a major downtrend and lower than at A; it fell ~50% while the averages rose.

subject: Grand Auto (GAI)
marks: A peak ~24; B marginal breakout ~25 with arrow; resistance line ~24
pattern: false breakout; poor RS; weak volume
lesson: At B, RS was below zero and below A and volume did not confirm; it reversed and fell ~40% in a rising market.

subject: 'Head and Shoulder Bottom' (schematic)
marks: left shoulder, head, right shoulder; peaks A and B joined by horizontal neckline; breakout into uptrend
lesson: Buy the breakout above the neckline joining rally peaks A and B; rough symmetry is enough, but don't jump the gun.

subject: Unocal Corp (UCL) - Daily Graphs
marks: LS, H, two RS labels; Neckline ~24-25; breakout ~Nov 1986
pattern: H&S bottom (two right shoulders) on daily chart
lesson: H&S bottoms are easier to see on daily charts; buy the neckline breakout with volume confirmation.

subject: Unocal Corp (UCL) - Mansfield
marks: LS, H, two RS labels; neckline ~25 with arrow
lesson: Above the neckline at 24 7/8, with volume confirming and RS improving, it was a solid buy (to ~40).

subject: ASA Ltd (label 'ASE')
marks: LS (~32-35), H (~28), rally peaks A and B (~41-42), RS; neckline with arrow
lesson: Buy-stop filled above 42 1/2; second half bought on the pullback near 42; two-year-old resistance was weak; it reached 73 1/2.

subject: ARA Services (ARA)
marks: LS, H, two RS labels; neckline ~29-30 with arrow
pattern: H&S bottom with two right shoulders
lesson: Two right shoulders don't weaken the pattern; it was an excellent buy at 30 on the neckline break with impressive volume and excellent RS.

subject: Sunshine Mining (SSC)
marks: LS, H (early 1982), RS; downward-sloping neckline with arrow
lesson: A valid Stage 1 H&S bottom: break above the neckline and the MA, with sharply expanding volume and RS turning positive.

subject: TRW Inc
marks: LS, H (~10-11), RS; downward-sloping neckline ~14-15 with arrow
lesson: An H&S bottom completed as the MA turned up; the stock rose to ~34-36 by 1976.

subject: XYZ double bottom (schematic)
